messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: error-rate spike (5xx) and p50 latency climb for model variant `omni-v5-experimental` in us-west-2. Thresholds breached: 5xx > 1.5% (5m), p50 +120ms. Paging darren-oncall.

darren-oncall: on it. joining triage channel and starting impact assessment. who saw the spike first? link to logs pls.

bob.prod: saw it at 12:02 UTC. spike correlates with long-context requests (~8k tokens) from a small set of keys. looks like KV-cache miss/regression after last kernel tweak.

alice.sre: confirmed. stack traces show OOM evictions on a subset of pods then retries -> 5xx. for immediate mitigation, recommend removing traffic from the `experimental` variant and routing to `omni-v5-stable`. low-risk rollback.

cindy.support: two customers reported degraded responses: AcmeCorp (high qps) and BetaHealth (sensitive). flagged as P1 by support.

emma-cs: contacting both customers; letting them know we're mitigating and will share ETA.

bob.prod: plan: 1) set experimental weight to 0, 2) apply emergency qps slices for top keys, 3) monitor for 15m, 4) if stable looks good, keep suppressed for 1h then gradual canary. I can run the route change.

alice.sre: agree. execute route change and emergency quotas. CLI to remove traffic:```\nredwood route set-weight --model omni-v5 --variant experimental --weight 0 --reason "emergency: 5xx surge us-west-2"\n```

darren-oncall: run it and paste deploy-bot confirmation. also set a circuit-breaker so new ephemeral keys default to stable.
deploy-bot: route update accepted by orchestration (change-id: 6f8a3c). new weights: experimental=0, stable=100. change propagated to ~120 nodes in us-west-2. TTL 30s for traffic flush. :white_check_mark:

bob.prod: applying per-key emergency quotas for the heaviest keys to prevent cascade:```\nredwood quotas set --key acme-api-key --qps 8 --reason "mitigation 3076543210"\nredwood quotas set --key betahealth-key --qps 5 --reason "mitigation 3076543210"\n```

alice.sre: added temporary SLO alert override to suppress noisy alerts during mitigation window. will track true customer-facing error rate separately.

cindy.support: AcmeCorp acknowledged mitigation and asked for ETA. BetaHealth on standby for follow-up.

darren-oncall: monitoring dashboard: p50 in us-west-2 dropping back toward normal. 5xx dropping from 1.8% -> 0.2% over last 6m. continuing to observe. keep experimental disabled until 15m stable.

emma-cs: letting customers know we're seeing improvement; ETA message queued.

bob.prod: request: capture a snapshot of traces and heap profiles from affected instances before we fully recycle them. also record the exact kernel flags used in the experimental variant.

alice.sre: doing a headless dump now and archiving to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/3076543210/profiles.tar.gz.

darren-oncall: thumbs up. next steps: 1) keep experimental off, 2) rotate config to rollback kernel tweak in staging and run focused test, 3) if tests good, attempt a small canary with key-slicing (5%) with enhanced tracing. file postmortem ticket and assign to eng-runtime.

cindy.support: creating customer follow-ups for AcmeCorp and BetaHealth, will share timeline.

emma-cs: confirm we'll offer incident summary and SLA credit if needed.

bob.prod: added task: disable experimental auto-rollouts until root cause known.

alice.sre: adding temporary keywise rate limiter to prevent a single key from taking all burst capacity:```\nredwood limits set --scope key --policy fair-share --max-qps 50 --reason "mitigate bursty keys 3076543210"\n```

darren-oncall: good. set retention: monitor for 30m then reevaluate. if metrics stable for 15m, prepare a controlled re-enable plan. otherwise keep suppressed and escalate to infra lead.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and mitigations applied. Incident channel: <#incidents>. Pager owner: darren-oncall. Handoff ETA: in 4h (morning oncall). Please attach timeline + logs to ticket INC-2026-4312.

darren-oncall: handing off to morning oncall if stable. please don't re-enable experimental without approval from eng-runtime. filing brief now. :memo:

bob.prod: :thumbsup: will follow up with a kernel-flag revert PR and a postmortem draft.

cindy.support: closing active customer tickets as 'mitigated' pending customer confirmation.

emma-cs: customers updated. will join postmortem.

deploy-bot: monitoring hooks still active. will alert if error-rate > 0.5% for 10m.

alice.sre: final note: root-cause seems tied to memory-regression at scale; prioritize memory profiling for next deploy.

darren-oncall: thanks team. handoff in 10m unless regression. reminder: update INC-2026-4312 with timeline and customer impact.
